description.name: Entry
description.text:
Max HP +2000 to party, Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Starry Ring of Determination to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 1, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Ring of Determination: [Damage] or [Earth Damage] +5% to party if user has/does not have Realm Synergy
Interval Chase: [10 single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attacks] or [Single-target minor DeProtect for 5 seconds] & [Damage] or [Earth Damage] +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Realm Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast 1 to party & Quick ATB 1 to En-Earth members, removes Master Mode
